gates.audit_onnx_bundle: not applicable (single-task experiment, not a bundle merge)

risks: OneHot in ONNX Runtime only implements INT64 indices, forcing a costly INT64 cast for the final one-hot re-expansion.
Any intermediate touching the full 10-channel 30x30 tensor is charged in full by the official memory formula; only the terminal node's output (named 'output') is exempt.
GridSample already exploits that single exemption near-optimally; a Gather/Slice/OneHot-based tail could not be found under 3,956 (measured 25,840, worse than baseline's 5,525).
recommendation_to_fable5: Reject this candidate direction for task029; measured cost (25,840) is far above both the 3,956 acceptance ceiling and the 4,600 build-time abort threshold, and worse than the current baseline (5,525). Correctness (266/266 train+test+arc-gen, and 266/266 raw-output equivalence with the baseline) was fully achieved, so the algorithm itself is not the problem -- the official per-tensor memory charging model makes any Gather/OneHot-based crop of the full one-hot tensor structurally more expensive than the existing GridSample approach for this task. Suggest de-prioritizing further C-8/C-11 work on task029 unless a construction is found that keeps the terminal node's output as the ONLY large 10-channel tensor in the graph (as GridSample already does).
